name: The R Villa Bratan

facts.text: 3 bedrooms, each with a king-size bed, and 3 bathrooms.
A garden, a private entrance and outdoor seating with sun chairs and a balcony.
Air conditioning, WiFi and a TV.
Kitchen with stove, microwave, kettle, coffee maker, toaster, blender and a refrigerator with freezer; dining table.
Safe, hair dryer, iron and ironing board; linens, towels and toiletries are provided.
A crib and a high chair are available.
In Canggu, about 5 minutes by bike from the La Brisa beach club.
